changes:
New Features: 
• added an option to import/export your big upgrades in the Big Upgrade Customiser

Minor Changes: 
• extended the maximum big upgrade limit to 100 
• added ESC/Enter support when editing big upgrades 
• reworked the big upgrade sort button to switch between default, ascending, or descending by order or cost

Gameplay Changes: 
• reworked the energy boost catch-up mechanic to only apply once for each player that is behind the top player with over 5x as much score as them (still gives 20% of their best score though) 
• in the final round, added a Mega Energy Boost event that gives the loser 40% of the top player's best score if they're behind 50x as much score as all the other players during a match

Bug Fixes: 
• fixed several in-game toolbar flickering conflicts
• fixed an issue that caused the Predict Chance custom big upgrades to not correctly apply the desired effect 
• fixed bot opponents not being able to purchase cheap big upgrades in a clamped order
Scale Dice is now available on Itch.io! Check it out here: https://otheruser325.itch.io/scale-dice

Big upgrade customiser updates: added the option to restore to default or sort by ascending.
• added a maximum big upgrade cap of 60.
Added a new big upgrade effect: Economy Cap (sets max economy upgrade level).

Minor Changes: 
• added higher number formatting and the scoring display header now uses full number names (e.g. 1,000,000 as in Million).
• roll scoring multiplier is applied more consistently rather than Fixated.
Gameplay Changes: AI now buys upgrades faster, depending on their difficulty factor (Deucifer will go wild with this!).

Bug Fixes: 
• fixed an issue that caused the big upgrade toolbar to go out of bounds when interacting with the combo toolbar
• localisation translation fixes and improvements.

Added a new challenge: High Stakes, a dedicated challenge against two Medium computer opponents for those who love big numbers and high risk-reward gameplay.
• Economy can be upgraded up to 250 times in this mode, as well as some exclusive big upgrades to turn the tide to your favor!
Four new achievements have been added: Challenger, Problem Solver, Veteran Player and Neverending Experience.
Added localisation support for 6 languages: English, French, Italian, Portuguese, Spanish and Welsh.

Gameplay Changes: 
• you can now play up to 6 players instead of the usual 4
• added an option in the local game configuration menu to customise your big upgrades (as many as you wish). It can also replace the default big upgrades with your own upgrades to enhance the gameplay experience to a marginal amount!
• added a new default big upgrade: the "Rollicane", which gives a dice a 25% chance to spin during mid-motion roll, giving constant points the longer it spins (will still display the usual pip count like a regular roll).
• improved AI behaviour and difficulty scaling in the Medium, Hard and Nightmare difficulties, as well as some minor improvements to the Baby/Easy difficulty.

Bug Fixes: 
• fixed teams mode challenge winning logic to properly account for total team score instead of individual player score
• several UI-related fixes and improvements for an improved player experience
Added Challenges: a new way to challenge yourself against predetermined opponents.
Daily Challenge: play against 2-4 AI opponents with random rulesets each day.
Deucifer's Pit: an extreme challenge designed for veteran players wanting to risk giving their soul for the best odds.

Minor Changes: 
• added an option to toggle big upgrades during lobby creation
• improved dice and combo scoring UI in game

Bug Fixes: 
• fixed an issue that caused the Clairvoyance big upgrade to not function properly.
• fixed in-game toolbar interface behaviour when upgrading or ending turn.
• minor fixes and improvements.
Scale Dice Release!
